column1: # Alien: Isolation, Switch update 1.1.5_64113. Nintendo SDK 8.2.0, NVN 53.312.
# subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie and subsdk1 is the NVN shader compiler.
# The NPDM declares no system resource. The SDK asks for a 3.14 GB heap.
# The renderer sets near depth to zero. Prebuild the same pipeline variant.
# The Switch renderer requests a two-refresh hold in gameplay even with its
# 60 fps preference. Pace the Mac and iOS presents at one refresh by default.
